card.name: Partway through split drug names
card.fires_on: Fires on the middle piece of a drug or product name split into parts, such as the SD in TRANSDERMAL or od in levodopa. Seen mostly in label warnings and dosing text.

modes.label: TRANSDERMAL split
modes.description: The SD piece inside the word TRANSDERMAL in patch warnings and titles.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS AND LIFE-THREATENING RISKS FROM USE OF FENTANYL TRAN<<SD>>ERMAL SYSTEM

modes.label: Inside levodopa and other drug names
modes.description: The middle piece of drug names such as levodopa or sorafenib.
modes.example: Entacapone tablets should always be administered in association with lev<<od>>opa and carbidopa.

card.writes: The promoted tokens relate to wearing clothing, which fits patch wearing but the link is weak.
card.plain: It fires inside long drug names that get split into pieces, especially transdermal and levodopa.
